summary: Iteration 4 testing of the 3 new features: (A) Expense edit/delete with permission model + edited_at + balances/budget-flag recalc, (B) Recap music toggle + framer-motion transitions, (C) Recap link revoke. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter4_features.py with 11 focused edge-case tests — all 11 PASS (25s). Covered: edit updates description/amount/category with edited_at + list reflected + balances recalc; non-creator non-organizer meera → 403 on edit and delete; ORGANIZER aarav CAN edit meera's expense; malformed expense id → 400; well-formed non-existent id → 404; custom split not summing → 400 on edit; delete by creator recomputes balances; delete all expenses → total_spent=0 and suggestions=[]; food budget flag: cross fires ONE alert + sets budget_alerts_fired.food=true → duplicate suppression → edit-down still-over no new alert → delete → flag cleared from mongo → refire fires 2nd alert; __total__ flag: same clear-and-refire cycle verified; recap revoke: non-organizer → 403, organizer → {ok:true}, old token → 404 GET recap, re-share issues NEW token that works. Frontend Playwright (aarav on 'Alert Test' trip): edit-expense-btn + delete-expense-btn render per row (organizer sees them on any expense), edit dialog titled 'Edit expense' with description/amount prefilled, changing amount 111→222 shows in list with '(edited)' marker + balances tab reachable, delete-expense-dialog shows description+amount summary, confirm-delete-expense-btn removes the row. Recap: revoke-recap-link-btn visible for organizer, play-recap-btn opens recap-page, recap-music-btn toggles between speaker-slash → music-notes (bg-[#F9B384] highlight class applied when on, removed when off), recap-next-btn advances slide content (main text changes), no console errors from framer-motion. Revoke click → toast + navigating to old /recap/{token} URL renders recap-error testid (404 from backend). Logged in as meera (member, non-organizer) on same 'Alert Test' trip → Memories tab shows NO revoke-recap-link-btn (count=0). Backend regression: iter3 test file still on disk; iter4 focus tests all pass. Ingress ConnectTimeout flake documented in iter1-3 recurred on 2/11 first-attempt runs — mitigated by adding a lightweight in-file retry wrapper (test-code only, no product change).

minor.issue: Same ConnectTimeout flake to journey-planner-5.internal.stage-preview.emergentagent.com as iter1-3 (~15% first-attempt rate); mitigated by retry wrapper in test_iter4_features.py

critical_code_review_comments: routers_trips.sync_budget_alerts re-scans ALL expenses on every write (add/edit/delete) — O(N) per mutation. Fine now; consider a $group aggregation once trips near the 1000-expense soft cap.

update_expense/delete_expense fire notifications to every member on every mutation — a busy trip organizer editing typos will spam 'expense_updated' notifications. Consider dropping the notify() when the diff is trivial (e.g. description-only, or amount delta < 1%), or a debounce.

get_recap and recap_image intentionally leak member NAMES on public share; already documented in iter3. New revoke endpoint properly $unset's share_token so old holders 404 — verified. Consider persisting a `share_history: [{token, revoked_at, revoked_by}]` for audit if this ever becomes a compliance concern.

RecapPage createAmbient() constructs a new AudioContext on FIRST toggle only, but if the user rapidly toggles or navigates away mid-ramp the setTimeout/setInterval keep firing. Current dispose() on unmount is correct, but consider guarding start()/stop() against re-entrancy (e.g. an isPlaying flag inside the closure) to avoid overlapping chord playChord() calls if toggleMusic is spam-clicked.

TripDetail ExpenseDialog reconstructs `selected`/`customAmts`/`percents` state only in the initial useState. If a user opens edit, closes without saving, and reopens on the SAME expense, React would keep stale state — currently mitigated by `key={expenseDialog.expense?.id || 'new'}` which forces remount. Good, but worth a comment noting the key is load-bearing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (edit dialog + prefill + (edited) marker + delete + music toggle + slide transition + revoke → recap-error + non-organizer hides revoke)

seed_data_creation: test_iter4_features.py creates ~10 short-lived trips prefixed TEST_Edit_/TEST_EditPerm_/TEST_OrgEdit_/TEST_EditBadId_/TEST_EditBadSplit_/TEST_Del_/TEST_DelPerm_/TEST_DelAll_/TEST_Flag_/TEST_TotalFlag_/TEST_Revoke_. Frontend test added and later removed one TEST_editable expense inside the existing 'Alert Test' trip; 'Alert Test' recap share_token was revoked and re-issued during frontend test — a NEW share_token now exists on that trip (its old public URL 7YxFb3B5v5E is now invalid).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend Playwright hits http://localhost:3000 (public URL wraps in wake-up iframe on cold containers); REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is still the external URL so backend integration is honest. After login, redirect goes to /dashboard not /trips — navigate explicitly to /trips to see the [data-testid="trip-card"] list (67 trips as of this run — lots of TEST_ trips accumulating from prior iterations). Preview ingress ConnectTimeout flake persists; wrap network calls with retry. RecapPage music button applies bg-[#F9B384] text-[#0B4F6C] classes when on and bg-white/10 when off — assert on 'F9B384' substring in class. Framer-motion AnimatePresence is keyed by idx so the 'main' innerText will change across slides. To assert revoke worked from the UI, navigate directly to /recap/{oldToken} and wait for [data-testid="recap-error"].
rca_of_the_issue: No application defects found. All iter4 backend edge cases (edit permissions incl. organizer-edits-others, invalid id 400/404, bad custom split 400 on edit, delete perms, empty balances after delete-all, food+total flag clear-and-refire) and frontend flows (edit dialog prefill, (edited) marker, delete confirmation, music toggle, slide transition, revoke → recap-error, non-organizer hides revoke) work as specified. The recurring ingress ConnectTimeout is an infra-level Kubernetes ingress flake documented since iter1 and is not iter4-specific.
